critique: The delivered results establish a quantitative uniform path approximation and atom-safe one-sided coverage only for fixed finite cells, compact local alternatives, positive benchmark support, and uniformly nonsingular covariance. The calibration theorem obtains unconditional termination through a potentially very conservative analytic fallback; no implemented refined certificate or numerical comparison with the least-favorable quantile shows that the resulting bound is practically informative. The advertised application to Fang–Ridder–Xie’s three-arm commitment-savings frontier is absent: the note contains neither a fitted instance, a certified grid computation, nor a substantive temperature-selection result beyond allowing an arbitrary measurable functional of the defined plug-in frontier. Thus the framing overstates the delivered application and computational evidence, limiting the journal score despite the proved path law and impossibility theorem.
